skill.name: aeon
skill.description: Use Aeon for time series classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, segmentation, similarity search, transformations, distances, and benchmarking.
skill.summary: Guides Aeon time series machine learning workflows for temporal data.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Static findings were reviewed against the Markdown context. The flagged imports, code fences, ML terminology, environment example, and public URLs are benign reference material. No prompt injection, exfiltration intent, or hidden execution was found.

static_findings.snippet: Use grid search or random search:
1. **Fit on training data only**: Avoid data leakage
Categorize time series into predefined classes. See `references/classification.md` for complete algo
Predict continuous values from time series. See `references/regression.md` for algorithms.
Group similar time series without labels. See `references/clustering.md` for methods.
Predict future time series values. See `references/forecasting.md` for forecasters.
Identify unusual patterns or outliers. See `references/anomaly_detection.md` for detectors.
Partition time series into regions with change points. See `references/segmentation.md`.
Find similar patterns within or across time series. See `references/similarity_search.md`.
Transform time series for feature engineering. See `references/transformations.md`.
Specialized temporal distance measures. See `references/distances.md` for complete catalog.
Neural architectures for time series. See `references/networks.md`.
Load standard benchmarks and evaluate performance. See `references/datasets_benchmarking.md`.
3. **Check Data Format**: Aeon expects shape `(n_samples, n_channels, n_timepoints)`

content.value_statement: Time series projects need methods that understand temporal structure. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Aeon algorithms and workflows.
actual_capabilities: Recommends Aeon algorithms for classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, segmentation, and similarity search.
Explains expected time series data shapes for univariate and multivariate collections.
Guides preprocessing, normalization, imputation, feature extraction, and transformation choices.
Compares ROCKET, distance-based, shapelet, feature-based, and deep learning approaches.
Summarizes benchmarking datasets, metrics, and validation practices for temporal models.
limitations: It does not install packages or execute Aeon workflows automatically.
It needs user-provided data context, target labels, and task goals for precise guidance.
Deep learning guidance depends on available dependencies, compute resources, and training data size.
Model quality still depends on validation design, data quality, and leakage control.

use_cases.title: Select a Time Series Baseline
use_cases.description: Choose a simple Aeon model and validation plan before testing more expensive algorithms.

use_cases.title: Build Temporal Feature Workflows
use_cases.description: Plan normalization, imputation, feature extraction, and downstream modeling for temporal collections.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Scientific Benchmarks
use_cases.description: Compare Aeon estimators with suitable metrics, splits, and published benchmark references.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Baseline
prompt_templates.prompt: I have labeled time series data. Recommend a simple Aeon baseline and explain the expected data shape.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Preprocessing
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my time series task. Suggest Aeon preprocessing, normalization, and imputation steps that avoid data leakage.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Model Families
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare Aeon algorithm families for my dataset size, sequence length, labels, and compute limits.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Evaluation Study
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an Aeon benchmarking plan with metrics, validation splits, baselines, and reporting criteria for my time series study.

output_examples.input: A sensor dataset needs fast classification guidance.
output: Recommended a MiniRocket baseline for speed and strong accuracy.
Explained the required collection shape and normalization step.
Suggested validation metrics and a simple comparison baseline.

output_examples.input: A forecasting project needs model selection help.
output: Separated short sequence and long sequence forecasting options.
Suggested error metrics and forecast horizon planning.
Flagged validation leakage risks in temporal splits.

output_examples.input: An anomaly detection task needs evaluation advice.
output: Mapped detector choices to subsequence and point anomaly goals.
Recommended range-based metrics for window detections.
Explained threshold selection and review steps.

best_practices: Start with simple Aeon baselines before expensive ensembles or deep learning models.
Fit preprocessing only on training data, then transform validation and test data.
Use temporal validation splits and metrics that match the business objective.
anti_patterns: Training deep networks before testing fast baselines on the same task.
Normalizing or imputing the full dataset before the train-test split.
Comparing algorithms with different folds, metrics, or preprocessing assumptions.

faq.question: What is Aeon?
faq.answer: Aeon is a Python toolkit for time series machine learning with scikit-learn compatible APIs.

faq.question: Does this skill run code?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and examples for users to run in their own environment.

faq.question: Can it handle multivariate time series?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains Aeon collection shapes for univariate and multivariate time series data.

faq.question: Which algorithm should I try first?
faq.answer: Start with a simple baseline. MiniRocket is often a strong first choice for classification.

faq.question: Does it support forecasting?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes forecasting guidance, forecast horizon planning, and error metric selection.

faq.question: What did the security review find?
faq.answer: The audit found documentation-only patterns and no hidden execution, exfiltration intent, or prompt injection.
